description: Retrieve tickets modified since a specified start time using the incremental ticket export, and use the response's end_time for subsequent requests. The support type defaults to agent; select all to include other support types, and note that data from the most recent minute is not provided.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for incremental ticket export.

per_page.description: Number of tickets to return per page (max 1000). Default varies by API tier.
per_page.human_parameter_description: How many ticket records to return on each page. You can request up to 1000 per page. Use with next_page from previous response for pagination.
per_page.title: Per Page

start_time.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Use the end_time from a previous response for subsequent pagination.
start_time.human_parameter_description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) marking where to start fetching incremental data. Must be at least one minute in the past. Use the end_time from a previous response to get the next batch of changes.
start_time.title: Start Time

support_type_scope.description: Filter tickets by support type. Possible values are 'all', 'agent', or 'ai_agent'. Defaults to 'agent'.
support_type_scope.human_parameter_description: Choose which type of tickets to include: 'agent' tickets (default), 'ai_agent' tickets, or 'all' tickets. Use 'ai_agent' to get AI Agent-generated tickets only.
support_type_scope.title: Support Type Scope

inputSchema.title: GetIncrementalTicketsRequest
